newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH GOLD BOURSE VOLUME DROPS AS PRICES FIRM.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH GOLD BOURSE VOLUME DROPS AS PRICES FIRM.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell to 1,373 kg on Wednesday from Tuesday's 1,645 kg as demand eased in the market due to firmer gold prices, dealers said.
Gold closed at $328.00 an ounce and 1,725,900 lira per gram, from $327.50 and 1,725,400 lira at Tuesday's close in line with the international markets.
The Turkish lira firmed to 163,390 per dollar from Tuesday's 163,800, depressing prices in lira terms.
Some 69 percent of the total trade was conducted in lira terms and 1,168 kg was traded in the morning session.
